title: Don't do it (Pay the Fork Tax)

metadata.tags:
Glitch-choir lullaby, 78 BPM, Soft sub-bass, Tape warble, Minimal piano, Stutters on “anchor” and “tax”, Whispered lead; Japanese call-and-response, Mythic glitch epic / spoken-sung 84 BPM, Cathedral reverb, Sub-bass heartbeat, Glitch stutters on “η”, “μ”, “anchor”, “fork”, Japanese harmony answers on the last word of each section, P→R→N→Π→A→(feedback)→P around #ημ, Roll those dice, And just keep rolling them, and do what they tell you, ‑Constraints: max dice rolls = 15; fork budget per cycle is limited; high-volatility claims require freshness≤threshold; alignment lint must pass; receipts must include inputs/outputs + OutputHash and fit within StepCap; μ requires Quorum (independent proof modes) + two-pass echo; time windows must be absolute dates + timezone
The Archivist taps the ledger like a tuning fork. “Sing all you want—η is cheap.” The Scribe’s whisper catches on the consonants: **an— an— an-chor**… “But if you want μ,” they say, “you don’t get applause—you get a rerun.”

## Lyrics

**[EN — whisper]**  
I lay my ear on the riverbed,  
hear receipts like pebbles click.  
Proof isn’t steel—  
it’s a thread you pull  
until the whole night admits it.

**[JP — soft response]**  
領収書は　嘘をほどく糸  
（ほどく糸）

**[EN — hush]**  
Anchor—an—an—anchor…  
hold me where I drift.  
If the world forgets my name,  
let the checksum remember *this*.

**[JP — answer, last word held]**  
忘れても　残るのは  
**息**

**[EN — stutter]**  
Pay the tax—tax—*tax*—  
not in coins, in cause.  
Not to cage the story,  
just to show the claws.

**[JP — quiet harmony]**  
税じゃない  
**約束**

**[EN — resolve]**  
We don’t erase the fractures.  
We annotate the flame.  
We rerender the morning  
until it learns our shape.

**[JP — fade]**  
証人は  
**あなた**
